items.text: Going from Lamar Jackson to Tyler Huntley is a downgrade ... but for our purposes it doesn't really matter. Lamar officially ruled out.
items.why: Ankle injury; ruled out for SNF vs ATL.
items.implication: Huntley starts; Ravens pass game and Flowers/Andrews/Likely usage shifts lower ceiling.
items.opportunity: Isaiah Likely upgrade potential in Berry loves; monitor Zay Flowers Q.

items.text: Steelers officially placed WR Michael Pittman Jr. on injured reserve due to his foot injury; will miss a minimum of four games.
items.implication: Out at least 4 games; PIT WR depth chart reshuffle.
items.opportunity: Increased role for other PIT WRs like DK Metcalf if applicable or backups.

items.text: Arizona Cardinals finalizing trade of WR Marvin Harrison Jr.; informed he will be inactive for Sunday vs. Detroit as details finalized. Houston in mix for reunion with CJ Stroud. Trade expected post-Sunday games.
items.why: Trade finalizing; team informed him morning of inactivity.
items.implication: Zero fantasy production Week 5; long-term move out of ARI offense.
items.opportunity: Increased targets/snaps for remaining ARI WRs especially Michael Wilson.

items.text: Eagles RB Saquon Barkley (hamstring) ruled out for Week 5 vs Jaguars in London along with DeVonta Smith.
items.implication: Will Shipley primary RB; elevated TE Zach Ertz; reduced PHI offense ceiling.
items.opportunity: Shipley/handcuff snaps and carries; Goedert target bump confirmed IN.

items.text: With Ashton Jeanty questionable because of foot and ankle injuries, the Raiders elevated RB Roman Hemby.
items.why: Foot and ankle injuries; Hemby elevated as contingency.
items.implication: Game-time decision; monitor inactives closely for LV RB shares.
items.opportunity: If OUT, Hemby or other backups get carries; reverse if ACTIVE.

items.text: The cruelest thing to happen to anyone that drafted Marvin Harrison Jr this year is him not being active to face the Lions secondary.
items.why: Missed elite matchup vs DET secondary due to trade/inactive.
items.implication: Fantasy managers lose potential boom game; pivots needed in ARI pass game.
items.opportunity: DET-AZ game still high interest for other skill players.

items.text: Marvin Harrison Jr has 5 catches in 4 games. He wasn't a real factor in any Michael Wilson stuff. It is Kia Kendrick Bourne szn.
items.why: Low production (5 catches/4 games) even before inactive/trade; Wilson already producing independently.
items.implication: MHJ absence/trade has limited immediate fantasy downside beyond expected; boosts Bourne/Wilson opportunities.
items.opportunity: Michael Wilson and Kendrick Bourne role expansion in ARI WR room.

items.text: Jayden Daniels back/IN; Dallas Goedert IN; Olave IN per Friday final injury board. Multiple OUTs including Barkley/Lamar/Hall/Smith/Diggs/Johnston/Pittman.
items.why: Cleared on final board after prior uncertainty.
items.implication: Full roles restored; start with confidence.
items.opportunity: Daniels rushing + pass; Goedert TE1 with Smith/Barkley out.

items.text: Jeremiyah Love (ankle) off injury report/full participant and good to go; workload upgrade post-criticism with 4.8 clear of Allgeier despite ankle.
items.why: Ankle maintenance; full Friday, coach says shouldn't impact; role bump.
items.implication: Solid RB2 vs DET; clear lead over Allgeier.
items.opportunity: High snap/carry share expected; reverse any stale Allgeier beneficiaries.

items.text: Jets RB Breece Hall (quad) ruled out for Week 5 vs Browns; DNP all week, second straight miss.
items.implication: Braelon Allen full RB workload again.
items.opportunity: Allen snap/carry/target share expansion as lead back.

items.text: Loves Michael Wilson vs DET as WR10. Volume and red-zone work; now boosted further by MHJ inactive/trade.
items.why: Target volume vs DET; MHJ absence amplifies.

items.text: Jets activated WR Tim Patrick from IR; no game status designation for Sunday vs Browns. Also other activations/IRs across league (Chargers Matlock/Taylor act, Lance/Penning IR; Pats Hollins/Gilliam IR).
items.implication: Depth for NYJ WR room with Hall out.

items.text: Love Nico Collins @ TEN as WR8. Volume including red zone vs soft Titans defense.
items.why: Target-hog volume and red-zone work in favorable matchup.

items.text: Loves Chase Brown @ MIA as RB5. Gobbles targets and points; Brown Gobbler nickname; usage/matchup strong especially with CIN WR injuries possible.
items.why: High target share and soft MIA run defense; CIN injury cascade potential.

items.text: Loves Isaiah Likely @ WSH as TE5. Positional/coverage weaknesses; Lamar out may concentrate targets.
items.why: Matchup and potential Huntley target concentration.

items.text: Hates Jordan Addison @ NO as WR41. Tough matchup, thin role, usage numbers poor; injury wrinkle.
Hates Mark Andrews @ ATL as TE17. Thin role and usage issues with Lamar out amplifying risk.
items.conflict: Likely love vs Andrews hate consensus within Berry.

items.text: Hates Cam Skattebo @ WSH (RB20), Tony Pollard vs HOU (RB28), Jalen Hurts vs JAX (QB15). Efficiency, game environment, rough stretch/banged-up line concerns.
items.why: Efficiency/game script issues for RBs; Hurts recent form and O-line.
